title: JavaSchoolLab - JVM, Tomcat, database pool and cache
description: The inside of the application: memory, garbage collection, threads, CPU, the web server, the MySQL connection pool, SQL and the cache.

panels.title: Heap used
panels.description: Used heap as a share of the maximum. Above 85% for long = memory pressure.

panels.title: Live data after GC
panels.description: What is still in use after a full collection. A line that keeps rising = a memory leak.

panels.title: Time spent in GC pauses (share of time)
panels.description: Above 10% the application spends too much time collecting garbage.

panels.title: Open file descriptors
panels.description: Linux only. Close to the limit = connections or files are leaking.

panels.title: Tomcat threads
panels.description: Busy close to maximum = new requests wait. Alert: TomcatThreadsSaturated.

panels.title: Network traffic of the web server
Connections: active, idle, pending
panels.description: "Pending" above zero = requests are waiting for a free connection.

panels.title: How long a connection is held
Connection timeouts
panels.description: A request gave up waiting for a database connection. Should stay at zero.

panels.title: Cache lookups per second
panels.description: hit = answered from the cache, miss = had to ask MySQL.
